observations: Fixed-grid accuracy: naive 0.737548828125; exact-source dedup 0.753662109375; group-normalized scalar 0.801513671875; group-majority proxy 0.801025390625.

In the adversarial stress case, once one wrong correlation group contains 4, 8, or 16 distinct source IDs against two correct singleton groups, naive and exact-source-dedup readers fail while both group-aware readers remain correct.
True correlation-group IDs are privileged synthetic information, so the result does not establish formal H3 performance; it identifies an information-matching requirement for a future comparator.
